sum: Punjab Produce & Trading Co. Pvt. Ltd disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares in Birla Cable Limited, triggering Regulation 31(4) filing obligations under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011.
detail: Punjab Produce & Trading Co. Pvt. Ltd filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure with the NSE, signifying that it has crossed the 25% shareholding threshold in Birla Cable Limited and triggered takeover code obligations. The disclosure was submitted to the stock exchange on or around 19 June 2026. Under SEBI Takeover Regulations, such disclosure must be followed by specified actions-either a mandatory open offer (if crossing 25%) or exemption approval. The exact shareholding percentage, consideration amount, and timeline for any open offer are not specified in the primary source.
